criteria.requirement: Repair tqdm.cli.posix_pipe to combine retained tail with each bounded read before delimiter scanning. Handle delimiters split at every byte position, multiple/consecutive delimiters, delimiter-at-EOF, incomplete delimiter suffix and undelimited final record. Forward every original byte exactly once, preserve byte-count mode for delim=b"", record-count mode and full-record callback mode used by numeric --update. Reject nonpositive/noninteger buffer size and nonbytes delimiter. Keep caller stream ownership/flush behavior; incomplete records may require record-sized carry memory, not falsely constant memory. Do not decode or execute input records in the generic pipe helper.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
